name: Box-mod vaporiser
description: A rechargeable vaporiser: a black battery box with a small screen and a fire button, topped by a refillable tank. It needs a charged battery and nicotine liquid to work.
notes: 24 by 40 by 85 mm body standing upright with a 50 mm tank and drip tip on top, screen and buttons on +z. Battery and liquid use, and nicotine effects, need fields the content pass adds. The reference lists lifestraw as a variant, but a filter straw shares nothing with this shape, so it has its own row and draft (water_filter_straw).

name: Filter straw
description: A fat plastic straw with a filter inside. Drink straight from a stream or puddle through it and most of the dirt and germs stay behind.
notes: Own row rather than a ride on advanced_ecig, whose variant the reference makes it: 225 mm long and 30 mm across, mouthpiece cap at +x. filtering is a new quality name for drinking from unsafe water. box/volume x0.39: the reference's 592 mL is far more than a 30 mm tube fills; the model follows the real straw.

name: Glass bulb pipe
description: A thin glass tube ending in a round bulb with a hole on top, blackened inside from use.
notes: 120 mm stem 8 mm across and a 26 mm bulb at +x with a dark hole and a sooty patch inside. Glass draws opaque in the tile but stays see-through in the game. Mass follows the reference's 242 g, heavy for so small a pipe.

name: Glass spoon pipe
description: A hand-blown glass pipe with green swirls, a bowl on top of its fat end and a small hole on the side to cover with a thumb.
notes: 110 mm long, swelling from 10 mm at the mouth to 30 mm at the bowl end on +x, bowl hole on top and carb hole on +z. Glass draws opaque in the tile. box/volume x1.4 is the box round a tapering round body.

name: Tobacco pipe
description: A carved wooden pipe with a deep bowl, charred inside, a brass ring and a black stem.
notes: 150 mm long with a 34 mm bowl 45 mm tall at +x and the stem's bit at -x. box/volume x1.56 is the box round an L shape.

name: Single-hole punch
description: A small desk punch on a dark base, with a bright metal lever on top. It punches one hole at a time through a few sheets of paper.
notes: 90 by 45 mm base and 44 mm tall: a charcoal base, an aluminium punch housing at +x with its paper slot as a dark line, and a bright steel lever to its grip at -x, so the lever reads apart from the base. CHECK VOLUME (x2.2): the box spans the air under the rising lever. Taken apart it yields a short steel punch pin, steel and aluminium scrap, for the content pass.

name: Metal pen
description: A heavy steel ballpoint with a gold band, a rubber grip, a clip and a push button.
notes: 130 mm long and 9.6 mm across, tip at +x. writing reuses the quality name another batch gave markers. box/volume x0.45: the reference's 40 mL is the size of a pen in a pocket, not the pen itself. The four coloured pens ride on this model with their own finishes.

name: Black pen
description: A cheap plastic ballpoint that writes in black ink.
notes: Shares the metal pen model; the finishes map makes the barrel, clip and button black plastic.

name: Blue pen
description: A cheap plastic ballpoint that writes in blue ink.
notes: Shares the metal pen model; the finishes map makes the barrel, clip and button blue plastic.

name: Red pen
description: A cheap plastic ballpoint that writes in red ink.
notes: Shares the metal pen model; the finishes map makes the barrel, clip and button red plastic.

name: Green pen
description: A cheap plastic ballpoint that writes in green ink.
notes: Shares the metal pen model; the finishes map makes the barrel, clip and button green plastic.

name: Office scissors
description: Long steel scissors with black plastic loops. They cut cloth, plastic and cord cleanly.
notes: 180 mm long lying flat, 122 mm pointed blades opened a little toward +x. The reference's butchering is left out: scissors are not a butchering tool.

name: Child's scissors
description: Short scissors with blunt rounded tips and red plastic loops, made for small hands. They cut paper and thin cloth, slowly.
notes: 130 mm long lying flat, 84 mm blades with blunt tips toward +x. box/volume x0.73: the reference's 80 mL is roomy for scissors laid flat.
